Title: Public preview: Azure IoT Edge for Linux on Windows (EFLOW) continuous release

Body.Content:
This update release of Azure IoT Edge for Linux on Windows contains the following improvements below:

  • Support for Azure IoT Edge 1.2 which add:
    • Edge Identity Service
    • Integration with on-premises PKI infrastructure via EST standard
    • Storing certificats in HSMs via the PKCS11 standard
    • Ability to configure a nested hierarchy of IoT Edge devices
    • Generic MQTT broker
  • Microsoft for Defender for IoT can be enabled in EFLOW so that the system can be managed
  • Arm64 and AMD64 chip support

Learn more.
